standard.summary: Pilot 判定要降温时，学习率倍率要去往的目标值。
standard.effect: 默认 0.5（压到一半）。必须 > 0。实际移动速度受每步变化上限约束。
standard.avoidWhen: 调太小一遇尖峰学习率就崩。

standard_en.summary: The target lr multiplier when the Pilot decides to cool down.
standard_en.effect: Default 0.5. Must be > 0. Movement toward it is rate-limited per step.
standard_en.whenToUse: Lower it to cool more aggressively.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Too low collapses the lr on the first spike.
